A [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] '''Miskara''' who [[Miskara|led]] the [[Vagaari Empire]] and its people made contact with a [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong representative|representative]] of the "Far Outsiders,"<ref name="TUR" /> the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> by [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]]. The Vagaari agreed to help the Yuuzhan Vong with their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which would also destroy the Vagaari's enemies, while the Vagaari in turn began incorporating the Yuuzhan Vong [[biot]]echnology. After the invasion, the Vagaari captured territories once occupied by the people [[Death/Legends|killed]] by their allies.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Miskara was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
